name: Cisco XR NETCONF Lab
description: Jupyter-based lab for practicing NETCONF functionalities on Cisco IOS-XR. Includes Docker containers for telemetry collection and monitoring with model-driven telemetry data.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker containers for Jupyter lab, telemetry collection (pipeline), and monitoring (Grafana/InfluxDB).

eval_notes: Docker containers used for model-driven telemetry collection and monitoring. Includes Chronograf, Jupyter Notebook, and Iperf for traffic generation. Designed for DevNet sandbox environment. Interactive Jupyter-based NETCONF learning environment. Good for hands-on NETCONF testing with Cisco IOS-XR. Docker-compose provides monitoring stack.
